decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-27009859) exclusively characterizes resistance mutations in the ALK fusion protein (specifically EML4-ALK-I1171S and related variants) in the context of NPM-ALK TKI resistance. It contains no data, mention, or functional assessment regarding the FGFR3 gene, the S459I variant, or any gain-of-function activity. The evidence is entirely irrelevant to the claim.

citations.quote: IC50s of each resistant line compared to the parent line from which they were derived . . . Interestingly, cross-validation using the lung cancer-derived EML4-ALK fusion showed both similarities and key differences in the effect of mutations on particular drugs. Our study therefore characterizes novel NPM-ALK TKI resistance mutations, . . . Consistent with its original identification in EML4-ALK-driven systems, we find I1171S is potently resistance-conferring to FL5.12 cells dependent on this fusion.
